findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Inspector observed dairy milk, oat milk, and strawberry topping to be opened in the standing cooler without date marking. CORRECTED- the PIC stated the items were opened within the past 2 days. A date was placed on the items. Ensure all Temperature Control for Food Safety (TCS) foods that are not used within TWENTY FOUR HOURS are date marked. Date marked items must be used or discarded within 7 days.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).[P]

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT: The person in charge (PIC) is not a Certified Food Protection Manager (CFM/ CFPM). They stated they are scheduled to take the exam in one week. Ensure the facility is under the supervision of a CFM any time food is being prepared or served.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. [C]

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.comment: The PIC was unable to present Employee Health Reporting Agreements during today’s inspection. The inspector provided an English language handout and will be emailing a Spanish language handout to the PIC. Ensure all staff who handle food read and sign Employee Health Reporting Agreements. Inspector will return on 02/06/26 to check for compliance.
findings.citation_text: 2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A). [Pf]

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment:
Multiple Temperature Control for Food Safety (TCS) items were observed above 41F.
1) FIRST REPEAT: Individual cream cheese portions from both the top and bottom of the storage canisters were probed to have internal temperatures between 58-62F.
2) Strawberry topping was probed to have an internal temperature of 63F. 
CORRECTED- The PIC stated and will be discarded after today’s breakfast service. The PIC will check with upper management moving forward regarding either keeping these items on an ice bath, or using Time as a Control for Food Safety (TAC).
Inspector will spot check cold holding during the 02/06/26 follow up.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less. [P]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Inspector observed yogurt, orange juice, and apple juice in the self service dispensers to lack date marking. CORRECTED- the PIC placed dates on the aforementioned items. Ensure all TCS foods are date marked when opened, to be used or discarded within seven days. The day the item is opened counts as DAY ONE.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A). [P]

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.comment: Inspector observed individual cream cheese packets stored on top of an ice pack at the breakfast counter. These ice packs are unable to provide sufficient cooling for TCS foods (which should be held at or below 41F). See violation #22 for details. PIC will inform inspector on or by 02/06/26 weather the facility will move forward using ice baths to cold hold TCS foods, or use TAC.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.15(A) Cooling Methods. (A) Cooling shall be accomplished in accordance with the time and temperature criteria specified under § 3-501.14 by using one or more of the following methods based on the type of FOOD being cooled: (1) Placing the food in shallow pans; (2) Separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; (3) Using rapid cooling equipment; (4) Stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; (5) Using containers that facilitate heat transfer; (6) Adding ice as an ingredient; or (7) Other effective methods. [Pf]

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: Inspector observed single service knives and spoons positioned in a mixed orientation at the breakfast counter. CORRECTED- the PIC rearranged the single service items with gloved hands so that the hand-contact surface is positioned outward. Ensure this practice continues moving forward to prevent the bare-hand contamination of food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11(A) Kitchenware and Tableware. (A) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of FOOD- and lip-contact surfaces is prevented. [C]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: No sanitizer bucket was available at the start of today’s inspection. CORRECTED- the PIC made a sanitizer bucket and education occurred regarding availability. Ensure a sanitizer bucket is ready and available during all times in which food is being prepared or served.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. [Pf]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an accumulation of food debris on the bottom of the kitchen’s standing cooler. Ensure all nonfood contact surfaces and equipment are cleaned at a frequency to prevent the accumulation of debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. [C]

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: PIC is not a Certified Food Protection Manager. He is currently working on completing his CFM certificate. Ensure the facility is under the supervision of a CFM any time food is being prepared or served.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. [C]

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment:
Yogurt cups and individual cream cheese portions were observed on the breakfast counter at 50-60F. The top layer of yogurt cups were out of temperature and will be discarded after this breakfast service. The bottom layer of cups was observed at 36F. Only stock one layer of yogurt cups at a time to ensure they stay at 41F or below. 
Cream cheese portions will be voluntarily discarded at the end of this breakfast service. Time as a control will be used for cream cheese portions, meaning any remaining at the end of breakfast service will be discarded.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less. [P]

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Facility does not have a probe thermometer. Ensure a probe thermometer is available for measuring food temperatures.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.12 (A) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of FOOD temperatures. [Pf]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Quat test strips are not available in the facility. Ensure quat test strips are available and used to monitor sanitizer concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. [Pf]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Food debris (sprinkles) and spills (syrup or honey) were observed in the breakfast counter drawers. Clean the drawers.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: 1st REPEAT: The kitchen handsink is not sealed to the wall. Recaulk the handsink.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]
